equations.label: eq:lens_map
equations.premises_and_limits: A lens is a declared map to a likelihood object. No theorem says the two release maps have identical noise, observing seasons or nuisance completions.

equations.label: eq:packaging_def
equations.premises_and_limits: Composition of declared lens and completion maps; no formal Six Birds theorem supplies a physical error bound or a causal diagnosis here.

equations.label: eq:theta_hat_def
equations.judgment: conditional idealization, numerical surrogate explicitly scoped
equations.premises_and_limits: A maximizer must actually exist and be attained to instantiate argmax. Recorded optimizer successes are best-found endpoints, not constructions of global maxima.

equations.label: eq:dchi_def
equations.premises_and_limits: Nonnegativity follows from the actual endpoint likelihood ordering; directional asymmetry is allowed. No null-test calibration or global optimizer certificate.

equations.label: eq:block_decomp
equations.judgment: hypothesis must be supplied or exact native ledger used
equations.premises_and_limits: True additive terms have an exact sum law. Correlated covariance subblocks are not independent likelihood terms; repaired signed allocations retain the remainder, priors and normalization.

equations.label: eq:block_dchi
equations.premises_and_limits: Endpoint differences sum exactly over exhaustive terms. Signed coordinate accounting can be negative and needs native completion adjustments.

equations.label: eq:profile_loglike
equations.premises_and_limits: The exact maximum requires existence/attainment on its declared nuisance domain. Actual capped nuisance runs do not certify all-nuisance or global profiling.

equations.label: eq:profile_dchi
equations.premises_and_limits: Actual reference and cross endpoints share frozen values and appropriate nested free domains. No optimizer API success substitutes for extremality. Stored within-run unprofiled/profiled gaps use the same improved reference.

equations.label: eq:toy_gaussian_constraints
equations.premises_and_limits: Exactly Gaussian factors, positive widths and their declared product. A posterior interpretation requires a constant prior on the gated domain; real-data Gaussian adequacy is not established.

equations.label: eq:toy_combined_gaussian
equations.premises_and_limits: Completing the square derives the weighted mean and reciprocal summed precision. Nonnegative component means cannot produce a negative weighted mean; common precision scaling does not change it.

equations.label: eq:toy_trunc_mode
equations.premises_and_limits: Unique constrained mode is max(0,mean). Positive normalization is derived for the actual Gaussian law; a boundary density mode is distinct from an atom or a finite-bin frequency.

additional_mathematical_claims.limits: Hold first width and offset law fixed. Direction increases for positive first mean, reverses for negative first mean, is constant at zero; exact real probabilities need not change after binary64 rounding.

additional_mathematical_claims.judgment: Actual constructed Gaussian probability law, not an assumed normalizer
additional_mathematical_claims.limits: Positive sigma and interior quantile level; quantile existence is not a certified numerical inversion or real posterior approximation.

additional_mathematical_claims.judgment: Conditional law and exact CDF/tail identities
additional_mathematical_claims.limits: Retained CDF must be positive. An omitted-tail bound or positive lower CDF slope remains a required input for coordinate-error claims.

additional_mathematical_claims.judgment: Derived bound and probability subadditivity without independence
additional_mathematical_claims.limits: Actual marginal coordinate errors/risks remain supplied, not inferred from posterior credibility or MCSE.
Residual-selected templates can remove the fitted discrepancy by construction. No predictive success, cosmological repair or uniform floating-point accuracy follows.
